2.text: Nuko hariho umuntu witwaga Zakayo, yari umukoresha w'ikoro mukuru kandi yari umutunzi.

3.text: Ashaka kureba Yesu ngo amenye uko asa, ariko ntiyabibasha kuko abantu bari benshi kandi ari mugufi.

4.text: Arirukanka ajya imbere, yurira umuvumu ngo amurebe kuko yari agiye kunyuraho.

5.text: Yesu ahageze arararama aramubwira ati “Zakayo, ururuka vuba kuko uyu munsi nkwiriye kurara iwawe.”

7.text: Abantu bose babibonye barabyivovotera bati “Dorere, agiye gucumbika ku munyabyaha!”

8.text: Maze Zakayo arahaguruka abwira Umwami Yesu ati “Dore Databuja, umugabane wa kabiri w'ibintu byanjye ndawuha abakene, kandi umuntu wese nambuye ndabimuriha kane.”

9.text: Yesu aramubwira ati “Uyu munsi agakiza kaje muri iyi nzu, kuko na we ari umwana wa Aburahamu,

10.text: kandi Umwana w'umuntu yazanywe no gushaka no gukiza icyari cyazimiye.”

11.text: Bumvise ibyo yongeraho umugani, kuko yari ageze hafi y'i Yerusalemu, kandi kuko bibwiraga ko ubwami bw'Imana bugiye kuboneka uwo mwanya.

12.text: Nuko aravuga ati “Hariho umuntu w'imfura wazindukiye mu gihugu cya kure kwimikirwayo, yamara kwima akagaruka.

13.text: Nuko ahamagara abagaragu be cumi, abaha mina cumi arababwira ati ‘Mube muzigenzura kugeza aho nzazira.’

14.text: Ariko ingabo ze zaramwangaga, zimukurikiza intumwa ziti ‘Uyu ntidushaka ko adutegeka.’

15.text: “Agarutse amaze kwimikwa, ategeka ko bahamagara ba bagaragu yasigiye za feza, ngo amenye urugenzo umuntu wese muri bo yagenzuye.

16.text: Uwa mbere araza ati ‘Mwami, mina yawe yavuyemo izindi mina cumi.’

17.text: Aramubwira ati ‘Nuko nuko mugaragu mwiza, kuko wakiranutse ku gito cyane, nuko ube umutware w'imisozi cumi.’

18.text: Haza uwa kabiri ati ‘Mwami, mina yawe yavuyemo mina eshanu.’

19.text: Uwo na we aramubwira ati ‘Nawe, twara imisozi itanu.’

20.text: “Undi araza aramubwira ati ‘Mwami, dore mina yawe! Narayibitse ipfunyitse mu gitambaro,

21.text: kuko nagutinyiye ko uri umunyamwaga, ujyana ibyo utabitse, ugasarura ibyo utabibye.’

22.text: Aramubwira ati ‘Ndagucira urubanza ku byo uvuze, wa mugaragu mubi we. Wari uzi yuko ndi umunyamwaga, ko njyana ibyo ntabitse, ko nsarura ibyo ntabibye.

23.text: Ni iki cyakubujije guha abagenza ifeza yanjye, ngo bayigenzure, maze naza nkayitwarana n'urugenzo rwayo?’

24.text: “Abwira abahagaze aho ati ‘Nimumwake mina ye muyihe ufite mina cumi.’

26.text: ‘Ndababwira yuko ufite azahabwa, ariko udafite azakwa n'icyo yari afite.

27.text: Kandi ba banzi banjye batakunze ko mbategeka, nimubazane hano mubīcire imbere yanjye.’ ”

28.text: Amaze kuvuga ibyo ajya imbere, azamuka i Yerusalemu.

29.text: Ageze bugufi bw'i Betifage n'i Betaniya ku musozi witwa Elayono, atuma babiri bo mu bigishwa be ati

30.text: “Mujye mu kirorero kiri imbere yanyu, nimwinjiramo muri bubone icyana cy'indogobe kiziritse, kitigeze guheka umuntu. Nuko mukiziture mukizane.

31.text: Kandi nihagira umuntu ubabaza ati ‘Murakiziturira iki?’ Mumubwire mutya muti ‘Databuja ni we ugishaka.’ ”

32.text: Izo ntumwa ziragenda zibisanga nk'uko yazibwiye.

33.text: Bakizitura icyana cy'indogobe, ba nyiracyo barababaza bati “Murakiziturira iki?”

35.text: Bakizanira Yesu, bagiteguraho imyenda yabo bacyicazaho Yesu.

36.text: Akigenda basasa imyenda yabo mu nzira.

37.text: Yenda kugera mu ibanga rw'umusozi wa Elayono, iteraniro rinini ry'abigishwa be bose batangira kunezerwa, no guhimbarisha Imana ijwi rirenga ku bw'ibitangaza babonye byose bati

38.text: “Hahirwa Umwami uje mu izina ry'Uwiteka,Amahoro abe mu ijuru,N'icyubahiro kibe ahasumba hose.”

39.text: Abafarisayo bari muri iryo teraniro baramubwira bati “Mwigisha, cyaha abigishwa bawe.”

40.text: Arabasubiza ati “Ndababwira yuko aba bahoze, amabuye yarangurura.”

41.text: Ageze hafi abona umurwa arawuririra ati

42.text: “Uyu munsi nawe, iyo umenya ibyaguhesha amahoro! Ariko noneho bihishwe amaso yawe.

43.text: Kuko iminsi izaza, ubwo abanzi bawe bazakubakaho uruzitiro. Bazakugota, bazakurinda cyane impande zose,

44.text: kandi bazagutsembana n'abana bawe batuye muri wowe. Ntibazagusigira ibuye rigeretse ku rindi, kuko utamenye igihe wagenderewe.”

45.text: Yinjira mu rusengero atangira kwirukana abaguriragamo,

46.text: arababwira ati “Handitswe ngo ‘Inzu yanjye izaba inzu yo gusengerwamo’, ariko mwebwe mwayihinduye isenga y'abambuzi.”

47.text: Nuko yigishiriza mu rusengero iminsi yose, ariko abatambyi bakuru n'abanditsi n'abakuru b'ubwo bwoko bashaka kumwica,

48.text: icyakora babura uko babikora kuko abantu bose bari bitaye ku magambo ye.
